title: student_registration_api
description: Verify that a new student can successfully register by sending a POST request to /api/auth/students/signup with valid registration details and receive a success response.

title: student_login_api
description: Verify that an existing student can log in by sending a POST request to /api/auth/students/login with valid credentials and receive authentication tokens and access to the student portal.

title: industry_login_api
description: Verify that an industry partner can log in by sending a POST request to /api/auth/industry/login with valid credentials and gain access to the industry portal.

title: academician_login_api
description: Verify that an academician can log in by sending a POST request to /api/auth/academician/login with valid credentials and gain access to the academician portal.

title: institute_login_api
description: Verify that an institute representative can log in by sending a POST request to /api/auth/institute/login with valid credentials and gain access to the university portal.

title: student_profile_management_api
description: Verify that a student can retrieve their profile details with a GET request to /api/student/profile and update their profile with a PUT request to the same endpoint, and changes are saved correctly.

title: browse_postings_api
description: Verify that a student can retrieve a list of available postings by sending a GET request to /api/student/postings and can apply to a posting by sending a POST request to /api/student/apply.

title: student_applications_tracker_api
description: Verify that a student can view the status of their applications by sending a GET request to /api/student/applications and receive accurate status information.

title: industry_post_opportunity_api
description: Verify that an industry partner can create a new posting by sending a POST request to /api/industry/postings with valid posting details and see the posting listed.

title: logout_api
description: Verify that an authenticated user can log out by sending a POST request to /api/auth/logout and that the session is cleared and user is redirected to the landing page.
